posts.text: If you've ever walked building to building ready to lock in just to find every single seat taken, I built this for you. 📍 CramMap shows you how busy every study spot on campus is, in real time. Currently live at Western, Waterloo, McMaster, and Wilfrid Laurier. Coming to the App Store soon. If your campus needs this, drop the name below. Schools with the most comments are getting priority. 👇 #BuildInPublic #StudentFounder #ReactNative #UniversityLife #CampusTech
